description: RFC 3339 times, changes files (CSV and JSON) and the completeness check, judged by the Python reference (genesis_mesh.workflows.audit_pack parse_rfc3339, parse_changes, check_completeness; a synthetic store of observations, execution evidence, break-glass records, grant uses and judgements). TypeScript agrees but on json-ws-fs, json-ws-us, json-ws-nel, json-ws-bom, csv-cr, csv-blank-lines, csv-blank-first-line-only, csv-quote-00, csv-quote-01, csv-quote-02, csv-quote-07, csv-header-quote-inside, csv-lone-cr-lines, csv-field-over-limit, csv-field-astral-over-limit, csv-quoted-over-limit (it trims JavaScript white space, not Python's, skips a blank first CSV line, opens a quoted field at any quote and reads a lone CR as a line end). Left out: a time that falls outside the years 1 to 9999 in UTC (the reference raises OverflowError, this SDK refuses it), a time ending in a newline (the reference's $ accepts it), and a record whose ID is not text (the reference counts it, the SDKs read no record of it). An rfc3339 case gives value or refused; a changes_file case changes or refused; a completeness case the report (lines index the pool; the first cited of them are the cited entries). A CSV file the reference's csv module raises csv.Error for (a lone CR outside quotes, a field over 131072 characters) is judged refused, as this SDK refuses it.
